module: Flowgraph node "Activity Hook Trigger" (category once_instant, tag activity). Triggers a mission hook named by data.eventName ("start" by default), passing all custom input pins (except flow and reset) as arguments via mgr.modules.mission:missionHook. Marked "generally unused" (C.todo). No fixed pins; all types except flow are allowed as custom pins.
notes: Game C.todo: "This node is generally unused."

init.desc: Sets data.eventName = 'start' and enables allowCustomInPins and savePins.

workOnce.desc: Builds a table {pinName = value} from the input pins (except flow, reset) and calls mgr.modules.mission:missionHook(eventName, data).
